title: Freelance Services Escrow Agreement
payoutConditions: Released to the Freelancer when the Client approves the Deliverable
Released automatically if the Client has not responded when the 7-day review period ends

refund.description: Full refund to the Client if the Deliverable is not delivered within 30 days of the deposit

sourceClauses.quote: The fee for the Services is 1,000 USDC
within thirty (30) days of the deposit
The Client has seven (7) days from delivery to review
the Client is entitled to a full refund of the deposited fee
No party, platform operator or contract administrator shall have the power to withdraw, redirect or freeze the escrowed funds
